tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lam gyi smon lam lam bzang 'grub pa'i dga' ston bzhugs so// siddhi ku ru/ phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho yi/ /thugs rje 'phrin las gcig tu bsdus pa'i dngos/ /smin grol mchog gi lam ston drin can rje/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso/ /rigs lnga yum bzhi sems dpa' yab yum dang / /khro bo khro mo gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad la/ /brtse chen thugs rje'i dbyings nas dgongs su gsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis zab gsal ting 'dzin gyis/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba kun dngos gshin rje gshed/ /ma he'i zhal can dkyil 'khor chen po mchog /snang stong dbyer med bde chen ngang du bsgrub/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod bstod gtor ma yis/ /dgyes pa bskyed cing gang de'i dkyil 'khor du/ /zhugs nas dbang bzhis rgyud bzhi sbyangs pa sogs/ /bdag gzhan dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs kyis/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yab gcig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /gdul dka' 'dul mdzad khro rgyal gshin rje gshed/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog dpal chen bhai ra ba/ /ma rnams don du tshe 'dir 'grub par shog /de ma thob kyi tshe rabs kun tu yang / /mi khom gnas su nam yang mi skye zhing / /khams drug ldan pa'i skyon med rdo rje'i lus/ /dal 'byor bco brgyad tshang ba thob par shog /thun mong lam gyi rim pas rgyud sbyangs te/ rgyud sde'i rtser son dpal ldan dus dgra yi/ /dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bzhis smin byas te/ /dam tshig sdom pa tshul bzhin srung bar shog /tha mal skye shi bar do'i snang zhen kun/ /rang sems spros bral dbyings su thag chod nas/ /de nyid rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /'char byed zab mo'i rnal 'byor rnam bzhi la/ /sgro 'dogs chod nas thun bzhir bsgoms pa'i mthus/ /gzugs sku sgrub byed bsod nams tshogs rdzogs shing /

/gang snang lha yi 'khor lor shar gyur nas/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i nyams len mthar phyin shog /dag pa'i zhing mchog bla ma lhar bcas la/ /phyag mchod yan lag bdun pas tshogs bsags shing / /'gro ba'i tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgoms pa yi/ /sbyor ba sngon 'gros bdag rgyud sbyong bar shog /zab mo'i sngags kyi spros kun 'od gsal du/ /mkha' la na bun dengs pa ltar thim nas/ /de nyid ngang du mnyam par bzhag pa yis/ /'chi ba chos sku'i lam du 'khyer bar shog /dus me 'khrug pa'i rdo rje'i gur khang du/ /'khor los bsgyur ba'i khro bcu'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /phyogs bcur rgyu ba'i gdug can 'byung po'i tshogs/ /bsrung dang bzlog pa'i phrin las kun 'grub shog /e dbyings dur khrod 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du/ /byang phyogs yongs su dag pa'i gzhal med khang / /bsgoms pas snod kyi 'jig rten sbyong ba dang / /gang du 'tshang rgya'i zhing khams dag byed shog /mngon byang lnga las rgyu'i rdo rje 'dzin/ /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi skur langs te/ /rnal 'byor dang pos bar do'i snang ba kun/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku'i lam du 'khyer bar shog /'jam dpal dbyangs las rigs gsum spro 'du yi/ /rnam pa sa bon phyag mtshan rnam rol gyi/ /dga' ba gsum las brtan g.yo 'khor 'das kyi/ /khyab bdag dpal ldan 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin/ /zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa ma he'i zhal/ /yab yum zhal bzang sbyor ba'i ting 'dzin mchog /skye ba sprul sku'i lam 'khyer zab mo yi/ /rjes su rnam rol nyams len mthar phyin shog /yab yum mngon dga'i 'khyud dang tsumbha nas/ /chu skyes rdo rje rol pa'i tsaṇḍa lis/ /zhu ba'i bde gshegs byang chub sems kyi ngos/ /dhu ti'i lam nas zhugs pa'i sprin gyi bcud/ /shes rab padma'i ze'u 'brur babs pa las/ /'ongs pa'i dkyil 'khor nam mkha'i khams gang ba'i/ /phung khams skye mched ma dag snang ba kun/

/sbyong byed shin tu rnal 'byor 'grub par shog /de ltar dam tshig dkyil 'khor chen po la/ /ye shes 'khor lo dbyer med rgyas btab ste/ /mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang la sogs pa yi/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i lam mchog mthar phyin shog /de ltar rgya chen bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / /zab gsal zung du 'jug pa'i ting 'dzin la/ /ring du sbyangs shing brtan pa thob byas nas/ /sngags kyi 'khor lo bzlas pa mthar phyin shog /bsnyen bsgrub mthar phyin de yi bsam gtan dang / /bzlas brjod sbyin sreg 'khrul 'khor sbyor ba yi/ /grub pa chen po brgyad dang las chen bzhis/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan bde sgrub par shog /'bum phrag gshin rje gshed rgyud snying po'i don/ /o ḍi ya nar ye shes mkha' 'gro mas/ /grub pa mchog brnyes rol pa'i rdo rje la/ /legs par gdams pa'i snyan rgyud rdo rje'i tshig /rwa chen brgyud par bcas pa'i gsang ba'i gtam/ /zab pa bas kyang ches zab zhal gyi bcud/ /rdzogs rim zab mo'i nyams len mthar phyin nas/ /'jal dpal rdo rje tshe 'dir 'grub par shog /'khor lo rnam lnga'i 'byung ba rlung rnams ni/ /nyi zla'i lam nas dhu ti'i mas sna ru/ /chos 'byung chu skyes kha sbyor dbus zhugs pas/ /las su rung zhing dbu mar 'jug par shog /a thung phyag mtshan sa bon ti la ka /rwa rtse'i rnal 'byor mchog gi tsand+ra lis/ /haṃ yig zhu bas rtsa mdud kun grol nas/ /dwangs ma mchog gi bde chen bskyed par shog /dngos dang ye shes phyag rgya'i chu skyes kyis/ /ge sar las 'ongs bde chen sbrang rtsi'i bcud/ /yas babs mas stan bdud rtsi'i dga' ston gyis/ /lhan skyes ye shes nyams su myong bar shog /chos rnams kun gyi gnas lugs gdod ma'i gshis/ /blo 'das brjod bral phyag rgya chen po'i ngang / /mtha' dbus mnyam rjes med pa'i rnal 'byor las/ /nam yang mi g.yo rtogs pa mthar phyin shog

/rnam kun mchog ldan 'od gsal 'gyur med dbyings/ /mkha' dbyings shar ba'i dbang po'i gzhu ris bzhin/ /cir yang 'char ba'i ngo mtshar rol rtsed las/ /rnal 'byor sems ni lhug par skyong bar shog /de ltar ting 'dzin brtan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /shing shun gos gyon rus rgyan drug gis spras/ /bdud rtsi za zhing cang ti'u mi rkang 'bud/ /stag smyon zhon nas dug sbrul thod du bcings/ /hūm̐ phaṭa sgra sgrog mtshan mo rgyu ba yi/ /kun 'dar kun bzang spyod pas yul kun tu/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang lhan cig par/ /nyul bas nang gi sa lam bsgrod par shog /de nas bla ma lha yis lung bstan pa'i/ /padma can sogs nye rgyus mtshams sbyar nas/ /tshe gcig lus la gegs med bde blag tu/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin pa thob par shog /go 'phang mchog de dus 'dir ma thob na/ /rang sems skye med rdo rje 'jigs byed de/ /tshangs bug nas thon dag pa'i mkha' dbyings su/ /bsgrod nas lam mchog mtha' ru phyin par shog /'di phyi bar do'i gnas skabs thams cad du/ /bla ma rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dkyil 'khor pas/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i cir snang dge sbyor gyi/ /bskul mar shes pa'i dga' bdes 'tsho bar shog /rgya bod mkhas grub bye bas bsgrod pa'i lam/ /gshin rje gshed dpal lam mchog zab mo 'di/ /ches cher rgyas shing ring du mi nyams par/ /skal bzang skye bo'i nyer 'tshor gnas gyur cig /de nyid skyong bar zhal bzhes srung ma'i tshogs/ /las kyi gshin rje dam can rgya mtshor bcas/ /mthu stobs drag shul ldan pa'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /g.yel ba med par rtag tu 'grogs byed shog /ces dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi bskyed rim dang / rdzogs rim rwa khrid mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi lam gyi rim pa dang sbyar ba'i smon lam rab tu byed pa lam bzang drug pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba 'di ni dpal gshin rje gshed ma he'i zhal gyi rnal 'byor pa blo gsal rgya mtshos dge 'phel ri bo'i spo la gnas pa'i tshe sbyar ba grub par gyur cig/
